cost_basis: original native kernel Q4/n8 packed weight group-scale memory ledger; excludes RSS and execution memory
randomization: for each of seven roles independently, sample the same layer cardinality as frozen qv8 policy from 28 layers with Python Random(seed); deterministic role-order k/q/v/o/gate/up/down locked; no evaluation logits used
primary_comparison: source_qv8_28n8 vs five equal-bytes random28 masks
secondary: all Q4 baseline; original v2 28n8 (non-equal bytes if source role distribution differs); within-source fixed mask pairwise

dataset_protocol.rationale: RACE middle/test has only 55 unique full-untruncated <=208 token passages; RACE high/test has only 2. Original RACE 128+128 design infeasible. Revised before Qv13 C forward.
dataset_protocol.selection: valid complete non-truncated question and exactly four unique options; stable order by SHA256(dataset alias + id + question), then first 128 from each; no performance-based sampling
dataset_protocol.per_prompt: original Qwen ChatML user message, Choose the correct answer, Question full source, four options as displayed A-D, Answer using one letter A, B, C, or D; source answer only for scoring
dataset_protocol.token_boundary: 18..208 Qwen tokens; each appended A/B/C/D exactly one token with unchanged prefix; verified distinct; no truncation
dataset_protocol.distinct_items: source ids must be unique within each dataset and datasets names distinct
dataset_protocol.raw_token_protection: owner-only lab on /Volumes/D50; no raw full text, token IDs, per-case results uploaded to GitHub
dataset_protocol.pilot: first 8 selected ARC test items plus first 8 selected OpenBookQA test items, predesignated subset of 256, cannot be used to retune source policy
dataset_protocol.confirmation: full 256 evaluation after locked masks; paired per-item bootstrap with 10,000 resamples and family correction for random-policy comparisons
dataset_protocol.public_test_caution: test datasets could have been included in upstream pretrained model; newly selected means disjoint from Qv11/Qv12 experiments, not guaranteed never seen by model

metric_contract.primary: full-vocab softmax correct one-token NLL, mean over 256 question IDs, paired
limits: cannot interpret fullvocab next-token NLL as multiple-choice conditional NLL
cannot report p50/p95 individual token latency without instrumenting native
no 28n8 dynamic switching by preparing fixed masks
